title: PowerToys Run application missing from the programs (Firefox)
author: jaraco

status.label: Firefox shortcut cache invalidation is a focused design candidate
status.detail: Firefox's normal shortcut intermittently disappears from both PowerToys Run and Command Palette while the private-browsing shortcut remains; reboot restores it and recurrence follows Firefox's self-update lifecycle.

next_action.label: Reproduce and design app-index refresh
next_action.reason: Use a controlled Firefox update to identify the shared shortcut replacement event missed by both app catalogs.

judgment.rationale: The reporter supplied repeated occurrences, screenshots, and a fresh 2026 diagnostic. Both launchers enumerate Start Menu shortcuts and maintain file-system-watcher-backed repositories, making transient shortcut replacement/cache invalidation the strongest bounded hypothesis.
evidence: The normal Firefox shortcut is absent while Firefox Private Browsing remains and Windows Search still sees Firefox.
Restarting the computer restores the result, but the issue later recurs.
The reporter suspects Firefox updates and reproduced the same missing result in Command Palette on 0.100-era builds.
Both launcher implementations watch Start Menu, common Start Menu, desktop, and common desktop paths.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a focused app-index refresh design after reproducing Firefox's shortcut replacement sequence against both catalogs.

fix_assessment.rationale: No linked fix or owner covers the intermittent stale shortcut state. The shared symptom supports a repository change, but the exact missed file-system event still needs maintainer reproduction.

proposed_fixes.title: Make app repositories converge after atomic shortcut replacement
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A Firefox update likely replaces the normal Start Menu shortcut through a file-system event sequence that leaves the PowerToys Run and Command Palette program caches stale until a full startup rebuild.
plan: Capture the exact Firefox `.lnk` event sequence and compare it with both repositories' watcher subscriptions and filters.
Normalize create/delete/rename/change handling so atomic replacement invalidates the old record and reparses the final shortcut.
Add tests that replace a shortcut while preserving a sibling shortcut and assert both app catalogs converge without restart.
verification: Update Firefox and verify both normal and private entries remain discoverable in both launchers.
Simulate atomic `.lnk` replacement and confirm no stale or missing cache entry remains.
Confirm ordinary Start Menu create, rename, delete, and duplicate handling are unchanged.

confidence.rationale: Repeated reboot recovery and two app catalogs support stale indexing, but the exact watcher event and parser outcome have not been captured.

issue_context.summary: Firefox's normal shortcut intermittently disappears from both PowerToys Run and Command Palette while the private-browsing shortcut remains; reboot restores it and recurrence follows Firefox's self-update lifecycle.
known_information: The report spans 0.85.1 through a fresh August 2026 diagnostic.
A reboot repairs the missing entry without recreating the shortcut manually.
The shortcut remains visible beside Firefox Private Browsing in the Start Menu.
PowerToys Run and Command Palette have separate Win32 program repositories but watch the same shell shortcut locations.
inferences: Firefox's updater may replace or rename its `.lnk` atomically in a way that leaves one or both cached repositories stale.
A full catalog rebuild on process start explains why reboot repairs the result.
issue_context.analysis: The next useful step is maintainer-side reproduction around a Firefox update, recording file-system events and repository cache mutations. That evidence can distinguish a watcher filter bug from shortcut parsing or deduplication.
initial_investigation: Read all issue comments, both diagnostic references, and the latest Command Palette screenshot.
Inspected the PowerToys Run and Command Palette Win32ProgramFileSystemWatchers implementations and their shared watched shell locations.
Found no linked PR, assignee, or duplicate in the public timeline.

actions.label: Design resilient app-shortcut refresh
actions.note: Starts the fork-side design workflow only; it does not post or modify anything upstream.

reproduce.module: PowerToys Run and Command Palette Apps
reproduce.version_requirements: PowerToys 0.100.2 or newer with current Firefox
prerequisites: Install Firefox so both normal and Private Browsing Start Menu shortcuts exist.
Enable the Applications plugin in PowerToys Run and the Apps extension in Command Palette.
steps: Confirm both Firefox entries appear in PowerToys Run, Command Palette, and Windows Search.
Allow Firefox to self-update or reproduce its shortcut replacement while recording Create/Delete/Rename/Change events in the watched Start Menu directory.
Query both PowerToys surfaces without rebooting and compare their repository/cache state with the actual `.lnk` files.
Restart only PowerToys, then reboot if needed, recording which action rebuilds the missing entry.
reproduce.expected_result: Both catalogs should converge on the current Start Menu shortcut set after Firefox updates, without requiring a reboot.
setup_requirements: Use a disposable profile or VM so Firefox can be updated between two known versions.
